title: DNA controls the dimerization of the human FoxP1 forkhead domain.
authors: Kolimi, Narendar; Ballard, Jake; Peulen, Thomas; Goutam, Rajen; Duffy, Francis X 3rd; Ramirez-Sarmiento, Cesar A; Babul, Jorge; Medina, Exequiel; Sanabria, Hugo
one_liner_zh: 该文结合单分子荧光、MD模拟与生化实验，揭示FoxP1 FKH结构域在DNA结合下形成无序二聚体并负调控复合物稳定性，精准聚焦TF-DNA互作动态机制，方法含AI/物理模拟，高度匹配课题。
abstract: Transcription factors (TFs) regulate gene expression by binding to specific DNA sequences and gating access to genes. Even when the binding of TFs and their cofactors to DNA is reversible, indicating a reversible control of gene expression, there is little knowledge about the molecular effect DNA has on TFs. Using single-molecule multiparameter fluorescence spectroscopy, molecular dynamics simulations, and biochemical assays, we find that the monomeric form of the forkhead (FKH) domain of the human FoxP1 behaves as a disordered protein and increases its folded population when it dimerizes. Notably, DNA binding promotes a disordered FKH dimer bound to DNA, negatively controlling the stability of the dimeric FoxP1:DNA complex. The DNA-mediated reversible regulation on FKH dimers suggests that FoxP1-dependent gene suppression is unstable, and it must require the presence of other dimerization domains or cofactors to revert the negative impact exerted by the DNA.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TFs）通过结合特定DNA序列并调控基因的可及性来调节基因表达。即使TF及其辅因子与DNA的结合是可逆的，表明基因表达受到可逆控制，但关于DNA对TF产生的分子效应知之甚少。利用单分子多参数荧光光谱、分子动力学模拟和生化实验，我们发现人类FoxP1的叉头（FKH）结构域的单体形式表现为无序蛋白，并在二聚化时增加其折叠群体。值得注意的是，DNA结合促进无序的FKH二聚体与DNA结合，负向调控二聚体FoxP1:DNA复合物的稳定性。DNA介导的FKH二聚体可逆调控表明，FoxP1依赖性基因抑制不稳定，必须依赖其他二聚化结构域或辅因子的存在，以逆转DNA施加的负面影响。
